stories.title: Distance Field Contract for Chat Messages
stories.description: Define and enforce the frontend contract for provider distance fields (distance_miles:number, distance_text:string) within chat message payloads to ensure consistent parsing and rendering in MessageBubble.

stories.title: Distance Formatting Logic
stories.description: Implement client-side formatting logic to normalize backend distance values into consistent, user-friendly strings (rounded miles, unit standardization, fallback handling).

stories.title: Render Distance in MessageBubble UI
stories.description: Enhance MessageBubble component to display formatted distance inline with provider results while preserving markdown rendering, spacing, and readability constraints.

stories.title: End-to-End Distance Data Integration
stories.description: Ensure distance values generated by backend (MAINT-DIST) flow through the FindCare facade and chat response payloads and align with the frontend contract without transformation loss or mismatch.

stories.title: Distance Display Test Coverage
stories.description: Add unit and UI tests validating formatting, rendering in MessageBubble, contract compliance, and graceful handling of null/missing distance values.
